name: indxr-video
description: Standalone Remotion workspace for INDXR marketing clips — deliberately OUTSIDE the Turborepo build graph (ADR-089). Own node_modules, own install, never deploys.

scripts.copy-source: mkdir -p public && cp ../../tests/playwright/capture/recordings/core-flow.webm public/core-flow.webm && cp ../../tests/playwright/capture/recordings/core-flow-dark.webm public/core-flow-dark.webm && for n in justice-empty justice-paste justice-cost justice-download justice-transcribe justice-success justice-library justice-viewer justice-speakers justice-timestamps justice-summary justice-export; do cp ../../apps/marketing/public/docs/screenshots/$n-light.png ../../apps/marketing/public/docs/screenshots/$n-dark.png public/; done
